subject: Staccato AZ outage — urgent customer bridge and routing mitigation
messages:
From: Dana Park <dana.park@skyline-retail.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: michael.torres@cobaltai.io
Date: 2028-06-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: High 5xx and token throughput collapse in us-east-1a - Skyline storefront

Connor — we started seeing a sharp spike in 5xx errors and a 65% drop in token throughput from our production traffic routed to us-east-1a at 08:58 PT. Latency P95 jumped from ~120ms to ~1.8s and multiple customer-facing flows are timing out.

We’ve attached a small sample of request/response logs and a synthetic trace. Can Redwood confirm whether you’re seeing the same on your side and advise an immediate mitigation? We need a bridge — this is impacting checkout.

Thanks,
Dana Park
Head of Platform — Skyline Retail
Dana.Park@skyline-retail.com

Attachments: error-sample-logs.txt
From: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Park <dana.park@skyline-retail.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-21T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: High 5xx and token throughput collapse in us-east-1a - Skyline storefront

Dana — thank you, we’re on it. I’ve spun up an incident bridge (PagerDuty INC-7890) and looped SRE and account execs. Short plan:
- Immediate: create bridge and enable emergency geo-steer to shift new inbound sessions away from us-east-1a to us-west-2 for Skyline traffic only.
- Short-term: enable the low-memory quantized variant (q4_0) as a fallback to reduce per-token latency for in-flight sessions if needed.
- Investigation: collect KV-cache stats, per-host queue lengths, and model-serving thread dumps from us-east-1a machines.

Rishi — can you confirm if we can trigger per-customer route steering from the control plane now and whether the q4_0 fallback is packable without schema changes? Hannah / Marissa — this looks like it will require an executive customer update and possibly a temporary credit if recovery takes >2 hours.

Bridge: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-7890
Drive: https://drive.google.com/incident/skyline-20280621

Connor O'Brien
Major Accounts, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-21T09:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: High 5xx and token throughput collapse in us-east-1a - Skyline storefront

On 2028-06-21 09:20 PT Connor O'Brien wrote:
> Rishi — can you confirm if we can trigger per-customer route steering from the control plane now and whether the q4_0 fallback is packable without schema changes?

Yes — control plane supports per-account routing rules; I can push a temporary policy to pin Skyline traffic to us-west-2 within 3 minutes. Preliminary telemetry shows:
- Elevated KV cache miss amplification on older hosts (us-east-1a) leading to sustained context fetch latency and queue buildup.
- A subset of model shards hit GPU memory pressure, triggering swap and increased 5xx.

Immediate ops actions I’m taking:
1) Push per-customer route rule to prefer us-west-2 and us-west-1 as fallback (gradual shift with 60s session drain).
2) Enable q4_0 fallback on the serving fleet for Skyline model variant; this reduces memory working set by ~35% in bench tests.
3) Clear prefix cache for Skyline keys to avoid thundering re-population while we shift traffic.
4) Start capture of thread dumps and kernel busy metrics and upload to incident Drive folder.

Expect to see error rate drop within 6–8 minutes of rule activation; I’ll post updates to the bridge.

— Rishi
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-21T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Exec update request — Skyline incident

Team — keep me posted in the bridge. Two asks for customer communications:
1) Connor / Marissa: Prepare a 15-minute exec brief for Skyline leadership summarizing root cause hypothesis, immediate mitigations, and ETA for full recovery. Use plain language — they care about checkout impact and any data exposure (confirm none).
2) Finance/CS: tentative offer of a 10% credit if recovery >2 hours; do not promise without approval but prepare the play.

Also loop in AWS SR (Sara Lin) for any underlying AZ host issues — Sara, can you prioritize checking host-level telemetry for us-east-1a? I’ve sent a short note to aws-sr@amazon.com.

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Reliability
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Park <dana.park@skyline-retail.com>
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-21T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: High 5xx and token throughput collapse in us-east-1a - Skyline storefront

Dana — quick update from our bridge:
- We activated per-customer steering; ~72% of new sessions are now landing in us-west-2. Error rate has dropped from 9.8% to 1.6% for routed sessions.
- We enabled the q4_0 fallback for Skyline traffic; median latency for fallback sessions is ~240ms.
- Rishi is still collecting thread dumps and will follow up with definitive root cause; no evidence of data exposure at this time.

Next steps for us:
- We’ll keep your traffic pinned to us-west-2 while us-east-1a stabilizes. If you prefer, we can make the geo-steer permanent for the next 48h window.
- Connor and I will run a 15-minute exec call at 11:30 PT to walk through status and next steps.

Apologies for the interruption — we’ll send a short post-incident summary with timelines and the logs you attached.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Lead — Major Accounts
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Dana Park <dana.park@skyline-retail.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: michael.torres@cobaltai.io
Date: 2028-06-21T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: High 5xx and token throughput collapse in us-east-1a - Skyline storefront

Thanks — we see checkout success rates returning to normal after the shift to us-west-2. Appreciate the quick mitigation and the clear comms. We’ll join the 11:30 exec call.

Please include the postmortem when available and keep us updated on the decision about the 48h pin and any credit discussions. We may need a short calendar hold for a follow-up review if the root cause requires application changes.

— Dana
Dana Park
Head of Platform, Skyline Retail
